categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies net_processing.cpp to change INV message handling, wtxidrelay filtering, and disconnect behavior for block-relay-only peers.
categories.rationale: Aligns INV message processing with BIP 144 specifications and fixes a check ordering bug when disconnecting peers that violate transaction relay restrictions. Commit 2eefc296d4 notes that 'BIP 144 specifies that MSG_WITNESS_TX is "only for use in getdata", so if we receive it anyway, ignore it', while the PR description notes that unexpected inv types previously bypassed disconnects on connections with relay disabled.
